props.title: Every fact carries where and when it came from

cards.head: Source on every fact
cards.body: ‘P/E 29.4’ isn't stored alone — it's stored with ‘source: screener, asOf: 15:29’.

cards.head: Freshness built in
cards.body: A price older than its window is marked stale — the agent then refuses to quote it as current.

cards.head: Derived, not guessed
cards.body: P/E is computed in code from a stored price and EPS, and links back to both inputs.

props.foot: This is the whole game: a number with no source + time never gets stored — so it can never be spoken.

props.title: Everything you asked to reason over — as graph nodes

cards.head: Earnings & P/E
cards.body: EPS, PAT, and P/E as metric nodes, each linked to the price and result they derive from.

cards.head: Quarterly results
cards.body: Revenue, PAT, margins per quarter, with YoY and QoQ computed and stored.

cards.head: News & roadmap
cards.body: NewsEvent nodes with sentiment; ManagementGuidance extracted from concalls.

props.foot: Five factors, one graph — so the agent can weigh them together, each fact cited.

props.title: Ask for a whole company view in a single graph query
props.caption: one traversal gathers price, metrics, results and recent news — all with provenance
props.foot: The agent's main tool: turn a question into a query, get back facts with sources attached.

props.title: Why grounding on the graph beats a model guessing
props.note: illustrative — accuracy on grounded, multi-hop financial questions
props.foot: The graph doesn't just find similar text — it returns the exact, sourced fact.
